en.hero_title: Smart Farming Decisions in Telugu & English
en.hero_subtitle: Detect crop diseases from symptom descriptions, upload leaf photos for visual diagnosis, and receive instant scientific agricultural advisory in your native language.
en.preview_voice_sample: "Paddy leaves are developing spindle-shaped brown spots..."
en.feat_nlp_desc: Type or speak your crop symptoms in Telugu or English. Our trained XLM-RoBERTa engine identifies 23 crop diseases and insect pests.
en.feat_voice_desc: Simply speak your problem in Telugu (te-IN) or English. Easy to use for farmers without typing.
en.feat_advisory_desc: Get proven organic, chemical, and cultural disease management remedies approved by agricultural scientists.
en.feat_weather_desc: Stay informed on pest outbreaks, rainfall alerts, and humidity warnings specific to your district.
en.how_subheading: Three simple steps to diagnose crop problems and protect your yield.
en.step1_desc: Speak or type crop symptoms in Telugu/English, or upload an image of the affected leaf/pod.
en.step2_desc: Our dual AI engine analyzes symptom patterns and predicts the disease or pest with uncertainty calibration.
en.step3_desc: Follow step-by-step spray recommendations, chemical dosage, and cultural practices to save your crop.
en.cta_banner_title: Dear Farmers! Protect Your Crops from Diseases.
en.cta_banner_subtitle: Detect crop diseases in seconds and get instant remedies in your native language.
en.dash_hero_title: Detect Crop Diseases & Protect Your Harvest
en.dash_hero_desc: Speak or describe crop symptoms in Telugu to receive AI-powered pathogen identification, spray dosages, and expert agricultural guidance.
en.dash_glass_desc: Identify pests and fungal diseases immediately using voice input when spots, holes, or curls appear on leaves.
en.dash_audited_db: Audited predictions from the local database
en.dash_empty_desc: Start by describing a crop symptom or uploading a leaf photograph to see your diagnosis audit trail here.
en.dash_weather_tip: High humidity (>80%) accelerates fungal spore germination. Check weather risk alerts before spraying.
en.predict_subtitle: Describe crop symptoms by voice or text. Our fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa engine classifies 23 crop diseases with calibrated confidence.

en.res_warning_desc: The reported symptoms appear ambiguous or match multiple overlapping crop conditions. Please consult a local Agricultural Officer or upload a clear leaf photo before applying chemicals.
en.advisory_subtitle: Integrated Pest Management (IPM), verified chemical spray dosages, and diagnostic follow-up guidelines.

en.advisory_etl_hint: Monitor field conditions daily. If damage approaches 10-15% leaf/panicle area, initiate remedial IPM action immediately.
en.advisory_chemical_safety_desc: Chemical sprays should be used strictly only when pest infestation crosses the Economic Threshold Level (ETL). Always follow package label instructions and consult your local Mandal Agricultural Officer or KVK scientists.
en.advisory_fu_alert_desc: Based on the reported symptoms, the pathogen could not be definitively confirmed. To prevent crop damage and save input costs, please inspect the following diagnostic questions in your field.
en.advisory_fu_sub_desc: Enter your answers to the questions above or describe additional colors, patterns, and spots noticed on leaves, stems, or fruits:
en.advisory_fu_obs_placeholder: Example: White powdery spots appeared on underside of leaves, or spindle-shaped lesions turned brown...
en.advisory_fu_warning_box: DO NOT SPRAY CHEMICALS: Spraying chemicals without definitive disease confirmation is strictly discouraged. Consult your local Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK) or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) for direct verification.
en.advisory_sample_gram: 🌿 Bengal Gram Pod Borer (శనగ కాయతొలుచు పురుగు)
en.advisory_catalog_sub: Instant access to all 24 scientific dossiers indexed from the verified dataset
en.img_subtitle: Upload or capture high-resolution leaf photographs for deep learning diagnostic inspection.
en.img_notice_desc: The image inference pipeline is fully staged. Once trained CNN weights are mounted in models/checkpoints/, visual diagnostics execute instantly. Meanwhile, our XLM-RoBERTa symptom prediction engine is 100% active!
en.img_dropzone_title: Drag & drop leaf photo here, or browse files
en.history_subtitle: Audit past predictions, filter by crop or disease, and review past expert recommendations.

en.history_no_matches: No records match your search filter
en.history_no_matches_sub: Try clearing your search query or selecting 'All Crops'.
en.history_isolation_badge: Farmer Isolation Active: Showing records exclusively logged under your account.

en.history_adv_empty_desc: Ask your first crop question to get expert agricultural guidance.
en.weather_subtitle: District-specific pest forecasts, humidity thresholds, and spray safety windows for AP & Telangana.
en.weather_alert_desc: Relative humidity (>85%) combined with night dew accelerates Blast and Powdery Mildew. Monitor nurseries closely.
en.weather_paddy_alert: 🌾 Paddy (వరి): Leaf Blast risk elevated. Avoid standing stagnant water for extended periods.
en.weather_cotton_alert: 🌱 Cotton (పత్తి): High humidity promotes Whitefly and Sucking Pest reproduction.
en.weather_chilli_alert: 🌶️ Chilli (మిరప): Powdery mildew and die-back fungi thrive. Apply sticking agents if rain threatens.
en.weather_spray_tip1: Best Spray Timing: Morning (7:00 AM - 10:00 AM) or Late Afternoon (4:00 PM - 6:30 PM).
en.weather_spray_tip2: Avoid Midday Sun: High temperatures (>35°C) increase spray evaporation and leaf scorch (phytotoxicity).
en.weather_spray_tip3: Rain Washing Window: Ensure at least 3 to 4 hours of dry weather after applying chemical sprays.
en.weather_spray_tip4: Wind Speed Check: Never spray when wind speed exceeds 18 km/h to prevent spray drift onto neighboring crops.
en.weather_support_desc: Connect directly with government agro-meteorological officers for localized thunderstorm warnings and physical soil test advisory.
en.auth_login_subtitle: Enter your registered mobile number or email to access your farm dashboard.
en.auth_reg_subtitle: Create your free Rythu Mithra account to save diagnosis reports and receive tailored advisories.
en.auth_field_mobile_help: Used as your secure login ID.
en.auth_left_desc: Log in to safely review your past crop diagnostic reports and recommendations.
en.auth_reg_left_desc: Creating an account ensures your crop diagnosis records and advisories are safely stored.
en.about_subtitle: AI-Based Multilingual Crop Disease and Pest Detection and Agricultural Advisory System.
en.about_mission_desc: Rythu Mithra is an end-to-end intelligent agricultural decision support framework tailored specifically for Indian farmers. It bridges language and technological barriers by enabling farmers to diagnose crop diseases through voice or typed symptom descriptions in Telugu and English, upload smartphone photographs of infected leaves, and receive immediate, scientifically vetted remedies.
en.about_stat_pathogens_sub: Covering major AP & Telangana cash and food crops.
en.about_stat_acc_sub: Evaluated on untouched held-out test split (104 samples).
en.about_stat_bilingual_sub: Complete Unicode preservation and Web Speech API.
en.about_frontend_1: Semantic HTML5, CSS3 with AgTech SaaS Design Tokens
en.about_frontend_3: Web Speech API (client-side speech recognition for te-IN and en-IN)
en.about_frontend_4: Vanilla JavaScript (AJAX, dynamic DOM updates, real-time filters)
en.about_frontend_5: Google Fonts (Noto Sans Telugu & Plus Jakarta Sans)
en.about_nlp_3: Class-weighted Cross-Entropy Loss to counter class imbalance
en.about_nlp_4: Calibrated uncertainty thresholding (safe fallback for ambiguous symptoms)
en.about_cv_3: Singleton model loader without placeholder artifacts
en.about_cv_4: Clean separation of concerns for modular weight deployment

te.advisory_fu_warning_box: రసాయన మందులు వాడవద్దు: తెగులు ఖచ్చితంగా నిర్ధారణ కాకుండా రసాయనాలు పిచికారీ చేయడం నిషిద్ధం. మరింత సహాయం కోసం స్థానిక కృషి విజ్ఞాన కేంద్రం (KVK) లేదా రైతు భరోసా కేంద్రాన్ని (RBK) సంప్రదించండి.
te.advisory_catalog_sub: ధృవీకరించబడిన డేటాసెట్ నుండి మొత్తం 24 శాస్త్రీయ నివేదికల తక్షణ సమాచారం
te.img_subtitle: తెగులు సోకిన ఆకు, కాండం లేదా కాయ యొక్క స్పష్టమైన ఫోటోను అప్‌లోడ్ చేసి విశ్లేషించండి.
te.img_notice_desc: ఇమేజ్ విశ్లేషణ పైప్‌లైన్ సిద్ధంగా ఉంది. models/checkpoints/ లో శిక్షణ పొందిన వెయిట్స్ లోడ్ కాగానే నేరుగా ఫోటో ఆధారిత నిర్ధారణ ప్రారంభమవుతుంది. ప్రస్తుతం మన XLM-RoBERTa టెక్స్ట్/వాయిస్ గుర్తింపు పూర్తిగా అందుబాటులో ఉంది!

te.weather_subtitle: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ మరియు తెలంగాణ జిల్లాలకు ప్రత్యేక వ్యవసాయ వాతావరణ సమాచారం మరియు తెగుళ్ల ఉధృతి హెచ్చరికలు.
te.weather_alert_desc: గాలిలో అధిక తేమ (85% పైగా) మరియు రాత్రి మంచు వల్ల అగ్గి తెగులు మరియు బూడిద తెగులు వ్యాపించే ప్రమాదం ఎక్కువ. నారుమళ్లను గమనించండి.
te.weather_paddy_alert: 🌾 వరి (Paddy): అగ్గి తెగులు వచ్చే అవకాశం ఎక్కువ. ఎక్కువ రోజులు నీరు నిల్వ ఉండకుండా చూసుకోండి.
te.weather_cotton_alert: 🌱 పత్తి (Cotton): అధిక తేమ వల్ల తెల్లదోమ మరియు రసం పీల్చే పురుగులు వేగంగా పెరుగుతాయి.

te.weather_spray_tip1: పిచికారీ సమయం: ఉదయం (7:00 - 10:00) లేదా సాయంత్రం (4:00 - 6:30) మాత్రమే మందులు పిచికారీ చేయండి.
te.weather_spray_tip2: మధ్యాహ్న ఎండ వద్దు: అధిక ఉష్ణోగ్రత (>35°C) వల్ల మందు ఆవిరైపోయి ఆకులు మాడిపోయే ప్రమాదం ఉంది.
te.weather_spray_tip3: వర్షపాత వ్యవధి: రసాయన మందు పిచికారీ చేసిన తర్వాత కనీసం 3 నుండి 4 గంటల పొడి వాతావరణం ఉండేలా చూసుకోండి.
te.weather_spray_tip4: గాలి వేగం: గాలి వేగం గంటకు 18 కి.మీ కంటే ఎక్కువ ఉన్నప్పుడు పిచికారీ చేయవద్దు.
